chapter: Stuff Smith Trio and New York
title: The RCA 52nd Street album arranged by Leonard Feather
summary: The group recorded an RCA album through Leonard Feather without realizing it would become historical.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Great musical pleasure. That's the reason I can remember it so well. And we -- we did an album at RCA. "52nd Street Theme," I think.
I might -- I don't have my words right here. Leonard Feather --
Oh, I think I have the album, yes. 78s.
A whole lot of people on it, right?

And we -- out of all those groups there Leonard talked RCA Victor into doing it. And I'm really glad he did. We had no idea what we were doing. We didn't know it was anything going to be that historical.
Yeah, you don't know at the time.
